$comment: v3 P4 — ONE set of cases the kit (TeachAnalysis, RecipeFile) and the server (apps/renderer/src/game-ads/learn/recipes.ts: analyseTeach, RecipesFileSchema) must agree on. analysis[]: a teach's presses as the recorder writes them, the export names the server sent (authored), the confirming replay's facts (or null) and the declared start -> the goal presses (indices), the dismiss names, the arrival, confirmed or not and a phrase of the reason. Both suites read this file; a drift is a teach the kit calls confirmed that the server does not. documents[]: learn/recipes.json documents both readers (the kit's RecipeFile.Read and the server's RecipesFileSchema) must read (ok) or refuse whole.

analysis.name: a popup close is a dismiss; the press that opens a new root is the goal; one replay arrives the same way
a press that removes its own root AND opens a new one is navigation — a goal, never a dismiss
a tab inside one screen changes no root — kept as a goal step
a dismiss AFTER the last goal press does not move the arrival baseline
a runtime clone, a tween and a tooltip are not in the export and never count toward arrival

expect.why: only 1 name(s) from the game's own files appeared

analysis.name: names seen in only ONE observation never confirm — the replay reached another screen

expect.why: did not arrive the same way: 1 of the 3

analysis.name: no replay ran — unconfirmed, never assumed

replay.why: the game stayed on its loading screen

expect.why: the confirming replay did not run: the game stayed on its loading screen

analysis.name: a replay whose press was refused does not confirm, and says why

steps.refused: the element is gone and no candidate is on the allowed names

expect.why: could not press step 1: the element is gone

analysis.name: a goal step whose name is shared with no telling label is refused as unstable — no replay is tried
a step that fired invoke-button is recorded but a replay does not press it
a gesture on the game world is a goal step a replay does not press yet
a recipe that starts from another recipe is not replayed until recipes chain
every press closed something — there is no path
a cheat run while teaching is a goal step, in order

documents.name: a whole recipe of every step kind reads
an empty book reads
extra keys are read past, not refused
a recipe that starts from another recipe reads
an unconfirmed recipe with no thumbnail and no commit reads
another schema version is refused
recipes that are not a list are refused
an id that is not r + 16 hex is refused
an unknown step kind is refused
a click with no name is refused
a point outside the screen (x > 1) is refused
a start from a recipe with no recipe id is refused
an unknown start kind is refused
a confirm state that is neither is refused
a recipe learned some other way is refused (P4 learns by teach only)
an empty dismiss name is refused
a stamp with no kit version is refused
a screen whose step is not a whole number is refused
an ask longer than 200 characters is refused
a hold longer than a minute is refused
a cheat step with no command is refused
not an object at all is refused

facts.$comment: the teach facts the kit posts (TeachJob.FactsJson over `state`) must be exactly `doc`, and the server's TeachFactsSchema must read `doc`; pressKeys / replayStepKeys are every key the kit writes on a press / a replay step, and the server's schema must know each one (an unknown key would be stripped silently).
